Related to #30

## Scope

Critical Use Cases only:

- `workstreams/critical-use-cases/schema-agentic-use-cases.md`
- `workstreams/critical-use-cases/use-case-inventory.md`

## What

Replace “step” terminology with “activity” in the use-case schema and inventory.

## Why

The working group agreed to use “Activity” instead of “Step”.
This aligns the use-case workstream with the taxonomy.
